query: supabase_migrations.schema_migrations.statements 에서 drift 객체 출처 탐색 (키워드 매칭 + 해당 migration의 DDL/GRANT 줄 발췌)
reset_credits_feature_note: DROP FUNCTION이 인자 없는 시그니처를 지정해 실제 grant_credits(uuid,int,text,text,text,uuid)/deduct_credits(uuid,int,text,text,uuid)는 삭제되지 않은 것으로 추론 (IF EXISTS라 오류 없이 통과). user_credits 테이블만 삭제되어 두 함수는 존재하지 않는 테이블을 참조하는 상태
harden_listboard_generation_jobs_ddl_exc: alter table public.credit_transactions add column if not exists operation_key text, add column if not exists original_operation_key text;
alter table public.credit_consumption add column if not exists transaction_id uuid references public.credit_transactions(id) on delete set null, add column if not exists operation_key text;
create unique index if not exists uq_credit_transactions_user_operation_key ...
create unique index if not exists uq_credit_transactions_refund_original_operation_key ...
create index if not exists idx_credit_consumption_transaction_id ...
create index if not exists idx_credit_consumption_operation_key ...
grant execute on function public.consume_credits_once(uuid, integer, text, uuid, text, text) to authenticated;
grant execute on function public.refund_credits_once(uuid, integer, text, uuid, text, text, text, integer) to authenticated;
harden_listboard_generation_followups_gr: revoke execute on function public.refund_credits_once(...) from public;
revoke execute on function public.refund_credits_once(...) from authenticated;
grant execute on function public.refund_credits_once(...) to service_role;
harden_listboard_generation_advisor_inde: alter function public.consume_credits_once(uuid, integer, text, uuid, text, text) set search_path = public;
alter function public.refund_credits_once(uuid, integer, text, uuid, text, text, text, integer) set search_path = public;
acl_explanation: refund_credits_once는 PUBLIC/authenticated만 revoke되고 anon은 revoke되지 않아(기본 ACL로 부여된 anon=X 잔존) 현재 exec='A-S'. consume_credits_once는 revoke 없음 → PUBLIC/anon/authenticated/service_role 모두 EXECUTE
